anchor_value: USD-denominated fair value columns shown with dollar signs

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Fenix Intermediate LLC (3) | Term Loan B - 11.81 % (SOFR + 6.50 %, 1.75 % Floor) | $ | 6,000,357 | $ | 6,037,866

findings.detail: FX02 is treating the XBRL unit identifier U_USD as non-USD even though the schedule fair value column is dollar-denominated.

rationale: The flagged field is fair_value_currency with observed value U_USD. The raw schedule of investments labels the fair value amounts with dollar signs on both individual holdings and the total investments row, so the holdings are USD-denominated. The issue is therefore the FX02 check's handling of the unit identifier U_USD, not a non-USD fair value in the extracted data.
